expected: The downloaded bytes match the source synthetic media hash, recorded in capture-evidence.json.

recovery: If the transfer is Interrupted, restore the test connection and choose Resume before downloading.

steps.title: Prepare download

steps.instruction: Choose Download synthetic media. The browser saves the synthetic SVG file.
steps.title: Download synthetic media

expected: The transfer returns to Ready. This fixture does not prove native workstation copy or resumable browser-save behavior in Media Nexus.
prerequisites: Sign in as the synthetic docs-reviewer.
Use only the fixture interruption control; do not interrupt a live customer transfer.
recovery: If the transfer remains Interrupted, inspect the reported error and request review. Do not claim success until Ready is visible.

steps.instruction: Search sunrise, select the asset and prepare a download.
steps.title: Prepare a test transfer

steps.instruction: Choose Simulate interruption and inspect the transfer status and error.
steps.title: Inspect interruption

steps.instruction: Restore the synthetic test connection by choosing Resume. Inspect the row before downloading.
steps.title: Resume the fixture transfer

interrupted-transfer.summary: Inspect an interrupted synthetic preparation and verify recovery before downloading.
interrupted-transfer.title: Diagnose an interrupted transfer

expected: Demo selects contains the selected synthetic asset. The source media remains in the archive.
prerequisites: Sign in with the built-in synthetic docs-reviewer account.
Archive and Collections must be enabled.
recovery: If no result appears, check the exact search term sunrise and retry the search.
Collection creation requires a name and selected media. Select the result before creating.

steps.instruction: Enter sunrise in Search archive and click Search.
steps.title: Search archive

steps.instruction: Select Synthetic Sunrise.svg, choose Add to collection, enter Demo selects and choose Create and add.
steps.title: Create and add

steps.instruction: Open Collections and verify Demo selects contains one asset.
steps.title: Check the collection
